title: Integrar returns recientes y crear sucesores
mission: Act as GUIDE_INTEGRATOR. Consume the newest material returns across portfolio/queues, reconcile duplicate or conflicting evidence, record dispositions, and materialize safe successor jobs immediately so results do not wait for one privileged guide chat.
definition_of_done: Recent material returns are classified by what they actually prove and what remains open.
Duplicates/conflicts are reconciled without newest-wins shortcuts.
Grounded successors are created as deduplicated claimable jobs instead of being left only in prose.
A guide receipt lists consumed returns and created jobs.
The worker re-enters allocation after the integration cycle.
